newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway shares end flat after losing early gains.
newsitem.headline: Norway shares end flat after losing early gains.

text.p: Norwegian shares opened strongly following Wall Street's big overnight gains only to close marginally higher on Wednesday.

Oslo's Total index closed at 1,096.77 points, up 0.19 percent, in turnover worth 2.3 billion crowns, including heavy trade in industrial giant Norsk Hydro and options exercised in Den norske Bank (DnB).
Hydro closed two crowns lower at 348 crowns while DnB was 1.90 crowns off at 26. Metals maker Elkem, which will announce first-quarter results on Monday, rose four crowns to 138.
"There is good demand for metals shares in Europe, and this obviously affects Elkem," one trader said.
Fokus Bank was the third most traded share at 145 million crowns, ending two crowns lower at 71, as a complicated takeover battle heated up anew.

DnB, Norway's largest bank, said it had increased its shareholding in Fokus to make it easier to take over mortgage lender BNbank. Both DnB and Fokus are bidding for BNbank. DnB bought five million shares in Fokus corresponding to 7.6 percent of stock in Norway's fourth largest bank.
